name: Hollis
bio: Carries three days of rations and eats them all on the flight in. Still first off the ramp.
notes: A Meshy community model, CC0 per the owner (from the owner's Drive folder, 2026-11-01, second batch; the community model's name as the download names it): a textured GLB in a T-pose, not rigged (no skin), so it is rigged here from T-pose landmarks found on the mesh (landmarks.mjs). A bearded soldier in an olive field jacket with webbing and a holster. Retired 2026-11-05 (owner: "Remove Briggs and Hollis"): off the roster, files kept; a saved choice plays WWII Infantry (RETIRED_LOOKS in looks.ts).
